ocr: OCR is opt-in and fires only when over 30% of pages are scanned, instead of running on every file, because Tesseract is a separate system install. Cost: a file with a few scanned pages among many text pages gets no OCR.
patches: Two monkey-patches on pdf2docx internals instead of a fork, because the cause is dead code upstream. Cost: they hit internal names with no upper version pin, and stay active for the rest of the process.
repair.lists: Built-in List Bullet and List Number styles, with custom OOXML only for lettered and roman lists, because built-in styles are decimal only. Cost: detection reads text prefixes, so prose that starts like a list can be misread.
repair.fonts: A static fallback table instead of probing installed fonts, so it needs no OS access. Cost: a font name the table does not know becomes Arial, and only body paragraphs are touched, not tables.
